text.en: The men from Nova Scotia, New Brunswick and the Province of Canada who worked together from 1864 to 1867 to create a new country are called the Fathers of Confederation.
text.fr: Les hommes de la Nouvelle-Écosse, du Nouveau-Brunswick et de la province du Canada qui ont travaillé ensemble de 1864 à 1867 pour créer un nouveau pays s'appellent les Pères de la Confédération.

source.quote: These men are known as the Fathers of Confederation.

verification.evidence: From 1864 to 1867, representatives of Nova Scotia, New Brunswick and the Province of Canada, with British support, worked together to establish a new country. These men are known as the Fathers of Confederation.

text.en: The Fathers of Confederation set up two levels of government: federal and provincial.
text.fr: Les Pères de la Confédération ont créé deux ordres de gouvernement : fédéral et provincial.

source.quote: They created two levels of government: federal and provincial.

verification.evidence: These men are known as the Fathers of Confederation. They created two levels of government: federal and provincial.

text.en: The old Province of Canada was divided into two new provinces, Ontario and Quebec.
text.fr: L'ancienne province du Canada a été divisée en deux nouvelles provinces, l'Ontario et le Québec.

source.quote: The old Province of Canada was split into two new provinces: Ontario and Quebec

verification.evidence: The old Province of Canada was split into two new provinces: Ontario and Quebec

text.en: July 1, 1867, is the official birthday of the Dominion of Canada.
text.fr: Le 1er juillet 1867 est la date de naissance officielle du Dominion du Canada.

source.quote: The Dominion of Canada was officially born on July 1, 1867.

verification.evidence: The Dominion of Canada was officially born on July 1, 1867.

text.en: Until 1982, July 1 was called “Dominion Day.” It marked the day Canada became a Dominion that governed itself.
text.fr: Jusqu'en 1982, le 1er juillet s'appelait la « fête du Dominion ». Ce jour rappelait le moment où le Canada est devenu un dominion autonome.

source.quote: Until 1982, July 1 was celebrated as “Dominion Day” to commemorate the day that Canada became a self-governing Dominion.

verification.evidence: Until 1982, July 1 was celebrated as “Dominion Day” to commemorate the day that Canada became a self-governing Dominion.

text.en: In 1864, Sir Leonard Tilley suggested the name Dominion of Canada. He was an elected official from New Brunswick and a Father of Confederation.
text.fr: En 1864, sir Leonard Tilley a proposé le nom de Dominion du Canada. C'était un élu du Nouveau-Brunswick et un Père de la Confédération.

source.quote: Sir Leonard Tilley, an elected official and Father of Confederation from New Brunswick, suggested the term Dominion of Canada in 1864.

verification.evidence: Sir Leonard Tilley, an elected official and Father of Confederation from New Brunswick, suggested the term Dominion of Canada in 1864.

text.en: Alberta and Saskatchewan joined Canada in 1905.
text.fr: L'Alberta et la Saskatchewan se sont jointes au Canada en 1905.

verification.evidence: Expansion of the Dominion … 1898 – Yukon Territory 1905 – Alberta, Saskatchewan

text.en: Newfoundland and Labrador joined Canada in 1949.
text.fr: Terre-Neuve-et-Labrador s'est jointe au Canada en 1949.

verification.evidence: Expansion of the Dominion … 1905 – Alberta, Saskatchewan 1949 – Newfoundland and Labrador

text.en: Nunavut became part of the map of Canada in 1999.
text.fr: Le Nunavut s'est ajouté à la carte du Canada en 1999.

verification.evidence: Expansion of the Dominion … 1949 – Newfoundland and Labrador 1999 – Nunavut
